title: Understanding the Problem
text: To solve this problem, you need to create a regular expression (RegEx) pattern that matches words containing the substring "cat" without any uppercase letters or spaces.

title: Identifying the Requirements
text: The pattern should match words like "cats", "concatenate", and "10cats10". It should not match words like "Cat", "CA Tacoma", or "CATcatCAT".

title: Using Character Classes
text: Consider using character classes to specify which characters are allowed or disallowed in the pattern. For example, you can use $$[**A-Z]$$ to exclude uppercase letters.

title: Handling Spaces
text: To ensure that spaces are not included in the match, you can use [**\s] to exclude any whitespace characters.

title: Constructing the Pattern
text: Combine the character classes to form a pattern that matches the requirements. Remember to include "cat" in the pattern.
